laws.rule: Nyungwe, Uwinka visitor-centre hiking area: the park operator states all park hiking activities are led by community freelance guides, available at Uwinka and Gisakura reception. Ten hiking trails begin at Uwinka. This is not permission for unguided hiking or a claim that every walk elsewhere in Southern Province needs a guide; live trail access is not yet checked.

sources.title: Nyungwe: hiking guides, reception centres and chimpanzee limits
sources.supports: Read directly: Read directly: all hiking led by community freelance guides, Uwinka/Gisakura reception and maximum eight visitors per chimpanzee community per day. Named park operator conditions, not province-wide law.

local-law.note: Uwinka area of a park spanning provinces, not the whole province. No fee or universal national guide law inferred.
